directions.thesis: The final hybrid restores an original identity-first hero and navigation, then places four compact detailed project cards and a complete visible archive in a direct document flow. It preserves the current Bolder Experience and Skills sections and uses factual evidence without giant case studies or interaction gates.
directions.hero_layout: Original identity-first hero: Farhoud Talebi, Software Engineer, existing tagline, Contact and Résumé actions, and subtle particle field; simple original-inspired navigation leads into the document flow with no project preview or current-evidence column.
directions.typography_personality: Condensed technical display headings with a calm sans body and utility monospace reserved for dates and technology metadata.
directions.image_strategy: Four featured assets use real DeenPath App Store screenshots at /images/projects/featured/deenpath-store.webp, a factual StockScanner editorial cover at /images/projects/featured/stockscanner-cover.webp, a factual Remote Admin Toolkit editorial cover at /images/projects/featured/rat-cover.webp, and the real Imposter Hunt icon at /images/projects/imposter-hunt.webp; the remaining 13 projects use existing factual covers in a visible compact alphabetical archive with Rental Cash Dam immediately before Rental Property Calculator.
directions.interaction_model: Direct document-flow interaction: all four featured cards, archive entries, evidence, and actions remain visible without project filters, selectors, giant/full-width case studies, or interaction-gated evidence; consolidated signal controls remain available.

directions.thesis: A full-width typographic manifest presents Farhoud's career and projects as a dense release ledger where verifiable records replace decorative storytelling.
directions.hero_layout: Full-width typographic manifest hero with a persistent left rail navigation fixed along the page edge.
directions.typography_personality: Wide grotesk display with tabular monospace for dates, versions, and record metadata.
directions.image_strategy: Projects rendered as dense release rows with small edge thumbnail stamps rather than large imagery; existing covers only.
directions.interaction_model: Expandable detail disclosures per release row plus scroll-progress interaction; the persistent left rail stays available for section jumps.

directions.thesis: A DeenPath-led cinematic sequence opens on a full-bleed flagship project and moves through projects as full-screen chapters, with skills and experience reached after the project evidence.
directions.hero_layout: Full-bleed flagship project first viewport led by DeenPath, with a bottom chapter dock for navigation.
directions.typography_personality: Humanist display face with a neutral body for narrative, editorial pacing.
directions.image_strategy: Full-bleed project chapter imagery for each project on desktop, led by the DeenPath cover; existing covers only.
directions.interaction_model: Desktop chapter/scroll-snap navigation between full-bleed projects with a linear stacked mobile fallback and a bottom chapter dock.

selection.rationale: The user explicitly selected the final hybrid: restore the original identity-first hero and navigation; show four compact detailed cards followed by the visible 13-item archive; preserve the current Bolder Experience and Skills sections; use factual DeenPath screenshots, StockScanner/RAT editorial covers, and the real Imposter Hunt icon in a direct document flow.
